## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-ON. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.20% | 1M: +0.59%) and VXX ↓ falling (1W: -1.46% | 1M: +6.02%) confirm easing fear, while EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.43% | 1M: +7.00%) shows global cyclicals strength.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit signal mixed: Credit Spread (1W: +0.19% | 1M: -0.83%) → flat, RECOVERY while HYG (1W: +0.26% | 1M: +0.35%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.33% | 1M: +1.31%) ABOVE TREND show shallow risk appetite. Stocks vs Bonds ↑ rising (1W: +1.48% | 1M: -2.23%) RECOVERY and VXX ↓ falling (1W: -1.46% | 1M: +6.02%) CORRECTION are second confirmations of risk-on tone.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-supportive: UUP ↑ rising (1W: +1.01% | 1M: -0.66%) RECOVERY and TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.20% | 1M: +2.80%) ABOVE TREND keep financial conditions mixed but not restrictive; SPY/TLT flagged NEUTRAL in the regime matrix.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Energy leading: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.67% | 1M: +12.57%) and XLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.25% | 1M: +7.55%) showing strength; Tech cooling with XLK RECOVERY (1W: +1.20% | 1M: -2.04%). Style: Cyclicals/value gaining vs growth.

**5. US vs Global?**
US modestly ahead: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.20% | 1M: +0.59%) while EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.43% | 1M: +7.00%) and EWJ CORRECTION (1W: -2.03% | 1M: +7.89%) show selective EM/Asia participation.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation present but uneven: ARKK RECOVERY (1W: +4.44% | 1M: -10.96%) and IBIT RECOVERY (1W: +3.70% | 1M: -24.83%) posting 1W bounces amid larger 1M losses, IWM RECOVERY (1W: +1.95% | 1M: -1.19%) signals small-cap catch-up.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Industrial/precious metals supportive: CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.86% | 1M: +1.37%) and GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.82% | 1M: +5.64%) show demand-led breadth; SLV RECOVERY (1W: +13.13% | 1M: -8.74%) volatile on short-term positioning.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy strong and broad: BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +11.41%) and XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.67% | 1M: +12.57%) confirming leadership while UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -3.38% | 1M: -11.95%) remains weak.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Equity breadth (9/11) plus SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.20% | 1M: +0.59%) and XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.67% | 1M: +12.57%). DIVERGENCE: XLK RECOVERY and XLF RECOVERY (sector 1W up but 1M flat/negative) are minor rotation signals—watch for widening 1M/1W splits.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor cyclicals/energy and select EM exposure given breadth and commodity momentum; reduce exposure to stretched thematic/crypto risk where 1M losses persist (ARKK, IBIT). Monitor credit spread and HYG/LQD dynamics for next risk inflection.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.67% | 1M: +12.57%) and TAN ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.12% | 1M: +14.39%) for commodity/capex reflation. BEARISH: XLK RECOVERY (1W: +1.20% | 1M: -2.04%) and XLP CORRECTION (1W: -0.28% | 1M: +7.44%) on relative weakness/rotation.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +11.41%) and USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.85% | 1M: +10.24%) — energy momentum intact. BEARISH: UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -3.38% | 1M: -11.95%) remains under pressure.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX ~25 (complacency/flip), HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health pivot), XLK/ XLF spread (watch Tech vs Financials divergence), SPY short-term support near the 1M range of recent pullbacks.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON with Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive and multiple confirmations from SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.20% | 1M: +0.59%) and VXX ↓ falling (1W: -1.46% | 1M: +6.02%). Energy and cyclicals showing relative strength (XLE ABOVE TREND, TAN ABOVE TREND) while Tech is in RECOVERY. Key risk: rising credit-watch signals and 1W/1M divergences in XLK/XLF—monitor HYG/LQD and sector rotation for the next directional cue.
